name: kidd-script-writing
description:
Creates deep-analysis short video scripts in "吟游诗人基德" (Minstrel Kidd) style.
Uses a five-section structure (Hook→Foundation→Core→Counterintuitive Answer→Conclusion),
with colloquial expression, "Farmer Lady" audience proxy mechanism, exaggerated analogies,
and data visualization tables. Outputs colloquial, internet-native, northern-dialect-flavored scripts.
Covers: international politics, finance/geopolitics, space science/astronomy, and hardcore tech.
Use when the user asks to write video scripts in 基德风格 or for deep-analysis knowledge video content.
